notes:
2026-09-12: migrated to the unified Fact/annotations model (fin/58, continuation of the fin/1-57 rollout). Real oracle text (Scryfall-confirmed, data/fin/fin_scryfall.json #58, combined name "Jill, Shiva's Dominant // Shiva, Warden of Ice"): front "When Jill enters, return up to one other target nonland permanent to its owner's hand.\n{3}{U}{U}, {T}: Exile Jill, then return it to the battlefield transformed under its owner's control. Activate only as a sorcery." ({2}{U}, Legendary Creature — Human Noble Warrior, 2/2); back "(As this Saga enters and after your draw step, add a lore counter.)\nI, II — Mesmerize — Target creature can't be blocked this turn.\nIII — Cold Snap — Tap all lands your opponents control. Exile Shiva, then return it to the battlefield (front face up)." (no mana cost, Legendary Enchantment Creature — Saga Elemental, 4/5). Both faces already correct in definition.ts pre-migration (built 2026-09-06 alongside the real engine primitives below); this pass only touched synergy.json/annotations-authoring.json/progress.json.

Same transform-DFC-into-a-Saga shape as dion-bahamut-s-dominant-bahamut-warden-of-light (front-face activated exile-then-return, back-face Saga chapters as named triggers) and venat-heart-of-hydaelyn-hydaelyn-the-mothercrystal (transform+Legendary self-interaction) — both used directly as house-style precedent, plus summon-bahamut's own real LORE-counter fact and crystal-fragments-summon-alexander's own real 'tap all lands/creatures your opponents control' fact (same `event:'tap'` vocabulary, `types` swapped Creature->Land here). compute-annotations.mjs's own combined-name transform-DFC lookup (fixed 2026-09-11 on Dion's own migration) resolved both faces' oracle text correctly on the first run, no further fix needed.

12 source + 3 sink facts, all real-annotated via a new annotations-authoring.json + compute-annotations.mjs, `value` resolved for real via compute-weights.mjs --slug (all 15 resolve to the neutral floor, 1 — none of this card's effects have a numeric trace magnitude to bucket: bounce/exile/return/tap/grantKeyword/putCounter-LORE are all non-amount effects). Front (`face:'front'`): (1) self-cast {event:'cast', from:'Hand', target:'self'}, typeLine-anchored 'Legendary Creature'. (2) self-enters {event:'entersBattlefield', to:'Battlefield', target:'self'}, same typeLine anchor — no `subject` (same as dion-bahamut-s-dominant's own self-cast/self-enters — neither ever had a subject-carrying sibling fact to merge from, so none added here either, per SYNERGY_DESIGN.md's explicit note not to opportunistically add `subject` beyond what a real merge requires). (3) ETB bounce (SOURCE) {to:'Hand', from:'Battlefield', target:{types:{not:['Land']}}, targeted:true} — no `controller` (real text has no owner/side restriction, 'other target nonland permanent' — same unrestricted-target shape venat-heart-of-hydaelyn's own Hero's Sundering exile fact and summon-bahamut's own destroy-nonland fact already establish); 'up to one' -> plain `targeted:true`, no separate optional-target field, per combat-tutorial/fin-48's own 'up to one target creature' precedent (confirmed: no such field exists in the vocabulary). (4) self-tap activation cost {event:'tap', subject:'self', target:'self'}, oracle-anchored '{T}' — same shape coeurl's/dion's/venat's own self-tap-cost facts use. (5)+(6) the exile-then-return transform (SOURCE) — {to:'Exile', from:'Battlefield', subject:'self', controller:'you'} + {to:'Battlefield', from:'Exile', event:'entersBattlefield', subject:'self', target:'self', controller:'you'}, both oracle-anchored on the full 'Exile Jill, then return it to the battlefield transformed...' clause — same two-fact shape dion-bahamut-s-dominant's/venat's own front-face transform already establish. Back (`face:'back'`): (7) LORE counter (SOURCE, real trace evidence — this card's own real engine-piloted scenario runs through saga.ts's real `advanceSaga`, confirmed 3 real `fn:'putCounter' counterType:'LORE'` trace lines) {event:'putCounter', counterType:'LORE', target:'self'}, oracle-anchored 'add a lore counter' — same real vocabulary summon-bahamut's own Saga chapter migration already established (NOT dropped the way summon-primal-garuda's/summon-choco-mog's own lighter `sequence`-style scenarios had to drop theirs for lack of trace evidence — this card's full engine-trace.ts pilot style genuinely produces the evidence). (8)+(9) chapter I/II Mesmerize (SOURCE, TWO separate identical facts — one per real chapter firing, same 'repeat per real occurrence' convention dion-bahamut-s-dominant's own chapter I/II Wings-of-Light facts use) {event:'grantKeyword', keyword:'Unblockable', target:{types:{has:['Creature']}}, targeted:true} — reuses the real `Unblockable` keyword this card's own 2026-09-06 build added to card.ts specifically for this ability (Forge's real shape is a temporary Mode$ CantBlockBy static effect, approximated via the existing grantKeyword/hasKeyword machinery, same as documented in definition.ts). (10) chapter III mass-tap (SOURCE, real vocabulary reuse — crystal-fragments-summon-alexander's own 'Tap all creatures your opponents control' fact is the exact structural precedent, `types` swapped to Land) {event:'tap', controller:'opp', target:{types:{has:['Land']}}, targeted:false}, oracle-anchored 'Tap all lands your opponents control'. (11)+(12) Cold Snap's own exile-then-return-front-face-up (SOURCE, same two-fact shape as (5)+(6)) {to:'Exile', from:'Battlefield', subject:'self', controller:'you'} + {to:'Battlefield', from:'Exile', event:'entersBattlefield', subject:'self', target:'self', controller:'you'}, oracle-anchored on 'Exile Shiva, then return it to the battlefield (front face up)'.

Sink facts (3): bounce-target (front) {to:'Battlefield', types:{not:['Land']}} — no controller, same unrestricted-target shape as the source side. mesmerize-target (back) {to:'Battlefield', types:{has:['Creature']}} — no controller (real text has no side restriction either — 'target creature', not 'target creature you control'). cold-snap-opponent-lands (back) {to:'Battlefield', controller:'opp', types:{has:['Land']}} — mirrors crystal-fragments-summon-alexander's own analogous opponent-creature want.

No baseline self-dies/self-graveyard fact and no back-face baseline self-enters (per this task's own standing instruction) — matches dion-bahamut-s-dominant's own precedent of a front-face-only baseline on a dense, already-continuous scenario.

One scenario (unchanged from the 2026-09-06 build, already the real engine-piloted shape this task's standing rule asks for — a Saga's chapters fire in a fixed sequence via lore counters, not player choice, so this is NOT the branching/Tiered case): cast Jill -> real ETB bounces the opponent's Treasure token to hand (logs as a real `ceasesToExist` line into 'Hand', not `moveTo` — CR 111.7, a token target of a zone-change off the battlefield never actually arrives; `verify-synergy.mjs`'s own `producedZone`/`producedEvents` `ceasesToExist` cases already treat this as equivalent real evidence, confirmed 0 hard failures) -> real turn passage clears summoning sickness -> {3}{U}{U},{T} exiles Jill and returns it transformed as Shiva, Warden of Ice (`saga.ts`'s own `transformPermanent` immediately puts the first real LORE counter and fires chapter I) -> chapter II fires on the next real draw step -> chapter III fires the turn after (taps the opponent's real Forest, then exiles Shiva and returns it as Jill). All 12 source facts get real, direct trace evidence this way; all 3 sink facts are real zone-shaped wants (no sink needs its own trace evidence, only a supporting produce/read elsewhere in the pool).

Checks run: `verify-synergy.mjs` scoped (0 hard failures; soft notes only: tapForMana x8, drawCard x4 (natural land draws, not this card's own effect), transform x2 — same mechanical-scaffolding noise every other engine-piloted DFC scenario already produces) and full pool (317 v2 cards checked, 4 skipped, 1 hard failure — magic-damper, a pre-existing, unrelated, concurrent-session gap, not caused by this task). `npx vitest run functional-model`: 238/238 passed. Real find-synergies.mjs diff (isolated old-v1-file-vs-new-v2-file swap against the live full pool, not a stale git-HEAD diff): -138/+532 lines. Losses: all 138 are the old v1 file's own presence-only `self-battlefield` SOURCE fact's matches (`{zone:'Battlefield', controller:'you', subject:'self'}` used to satisfy every unconstrained battlefield-presence sink pool-wide) — correctly NOT carried forward, per this task's own 'no presence sources' standing rule and the identical precedent already set for summon-bahamut's own `self-battlefield` deletion. Gains: 168 battlefield-presence + 71 entersBattlefield matches (the new front/back sinks catching real producers pool-wide), 283 'moves to battlefield (from exile)' matches (the two self-transform-return facts, front+back, each independently satisfying every unconstrained Battlefield sink — same documented two-independent-producers-one-sink duplication pattern venat's own migration already established), 2 'bounce' matches (the new ETB ceasesToExist-backed fact reaching the pool's 2 real bounce-shaped sinks), 2 'moves to exile (from battlefield)' + 2 'moves to battlefield (from library)' (incidental new sink/producer crossings), and 4 real 'self-interaction: second-copy-legendary' matches (CR 704.5j — Jill's own transform/enters facts matching her own Legendary-creature type via `factsInteract`'s self-check).
knownGaps: The RealCard backing self never actually changes its own name/types/subtypes when 'transforming' (no dynamic-transform mechanism exists) — every moveTo/log entry for this object says 'Jill, Shiva's Dominant' even during back-face chapters. Pre-existing, same as Dion/Jecht's own DFCs.

`sequence`'s new step objects (unused now — this scenario is a full engine-trace.ts pilot, not the lighter `sequence` harness) — n/a, superseded; kept only as a historical note that an earlier authoring pass considered the lighter style before landing on the real engine-piloted one.
Unblockable's grant has no duration tracking (permanent within the scenario, not 'until end of turn'), same caveat every other grantKeyword* use already carries.

'Tap all lands your opponents control' only demonstrates a single real tapped land in this scenario's own trace (the opponent seeded with one Forest) — mechanically identical whether one or many lands are tapped (the `tapAll` Effect kind iterates the real predicate-matched set), just not visually dramatic with a bigger board; not a modeling gap.

verify-synergy.mjs's full-pool run surfaced one unrelated, pre-existing hard failure on magic-damper (a concurrent session's own in-flight card) — not caused by or fixed in this task, flagged for whichever session owns it.
